facts.business: The company is engaged in the business of fluid handling – from supply of pumps to turnkey project execution, supplying a comprehensive range of pumps to the Industrial, municipal and irrigation sector and undertaking water management contracts.

guidance_or_targets.statement: The division is confident of an improved performance in the latter half of FY2027 with the improving scenario.

The International project division established in FY2025 with the South African subsidiaries Eigenbau and PCI along with MISA in Italy had a strong year with growing revenues and securing large contracts at PCI. This provides a robust outlook for this Division in the medium term and will be a focus area for the company.

key_risks: Geopolitical tensions and conflicts impacting global trade
Move away from globalization leading to tariff based global economy
Sector constraints affecting project division revenues
Estimation of project execution cost over long contract periods (2-5 years)
